name: Organisations' own branch and outlet lists — Chattogram Division
organization: Various organisations (each row's organisation in extra_json.organisation)
attribution: Branch / outlet lists published by the organisations on their own websites (see urls)
notes: Each row is a branch, sub-branch, ATM/CRM, agent outlet, service centre, hub or office exactly as its organisation lists it; not independently verified. District/upazila normalised to the seed's English names (published values kept in extra_json). Coordinates only where the organisation publishes them and they fall inside the row's district. Staff names, managers' and agents' mobiles and personal e-mails are not collected. No licence stated by any of the sites: factual data only. Checked and not used: Sonali Bank — branch list (the list is an iframe of /feedback/index.php/branches/get_branches; robots.txt disallows /feedback/* (ATMs and AD branches used)); Pubali Bank (Cloudflare 'Just a moment' JavaScript challenge (HTTP 403) on every URL); The City Bank (locator data come only through a Next.js server action that proxies the site's /api/, which robots.txt disallows; treated as disallowed); Southeast Bank (locator data endpoint needs an anti-automation request_validator_key); National Bank (TLS error (incomplete certificate chain)); Al-Arafah Islami Bank (connection timed out (twice, www and bare host)); Ansar-VDP Unnayan Bank (HTTP 500 with an empty body on every URL including robots.txt); One Bank / Mercantile Bank / HSBC (not collected this round (One Bank's list pairs every branch with its manager; Mercantile publishes only agent outlets with owners' names; HSBC has no locator)); Grameenphone (terms of use prohibit 'data mining, robots or similar data gathering and extraction tools' without GP's written consent); Robi / Airtel (Cirkle) (terms forbid reproducing or storing any part of the site without Robi's prior written permission); bKash (Cloudflare JavaScript challenge (HTTP 403)); Nagad (Cloudflare 'Attention Required' block (HTTP 403)); Rocket (DBBL mobile banking) (no list of service centres published); Upay (agent/merchant locator only (individual agents are out of scope)); Pathao (terms forbid robots, spiders and data mining); RedX (only delivery zones; pickup points need a merchant login); Paperfly (only a district list with placeholder counts; no branch list); Continental Courier (TLS error (expired certificate)); Korotoa / AJR Courier (no official website found); Delivery Tiger (connection timed out); Ibn Sina Trust (HTTP 403 for every URL including robots.txt); Medinova Medical Services ('coming soon' placeholder, no list); Praava Health / Prince Bazar / Khulshi Mart / Unimart (one or two sites each, or names only (Unimart): left for manual entry); Shwapno (outlets load from /api/outlet…, which robots.txt disallows (Disallow: /api*)); Grameen Bank (only zonal-office names; no branch list or addresses); Shakti Foundation (terms forbid automated systems (bots, scraping tools) without permission); TMSS / SSS / RDRS / Proshika (site unreachable (timeout / DNS / TLS errors) or no list); Jagorani Chakra Foundation (working-area district markers only, no branches); PKSF partner list (no partner/branch address list).
